definitions.gloss: noisy; tumultuous; in an uproar; agitated
definitions.explanation: Describes a state of noisy commotion or agitation, typically involving a group of people or a place that has become disturbed by an unexpected or shocking event.

examples.english: The entire country was in an uproar over the news.
